tools_helpful.evidence: build-events.jsonl turn 34/35: agent iterated dotnet build to surface CS errors one batch at a time until BUILD SUCCEEDED (build-output.txt).

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP MainPage.xaml.cs (lines 102-103) subscribes to app suspend/resume to init/clean up the camera; carried verbatim into WinUI 3.
failed_apis.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application in WinUI 3 has no Suspending/Resuming events (desktop apps are not process-lifecycle-suspended like UWP); the members simply do not exist.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the event subscriptions and their handlers. WinUI 3 desktop apps are not suspended; if teardown is needed, use the main Window.Closed event or AppInstance activation.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP MainPage.xaml.cs line 99 (standard UWP page-template line) carried verbatim.
failed_apis.root_cause: Inside a Page, the unqualified identifier 'NavigationCacheMode' binds to the Page's instance property (type NavigationCacheMode), so 'NavigationCacheMode.Disabled' is read as accessing the static enum member through an instance -> CS0176.

special_apis.special_handling: CaptureElement has no WinUI 3 XAML equivalent; agent substituted an Image preview surface plus a no-camera FallbackPanel (score note confirms present + graceful).

errors_encountered.error: CS1061 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending' / 'Resuming' (9x each across build attempts)
errors_encountered.root_cause: WinUI 3 Application exposes no Suspending/Resuming events.
errors_encountered.fix: Deleted the += subscriptions and their async handler methods.

errors_encountered.error: CS0176 Member 'NavigationCacheMode.Disabled' cannot be accessed with an instance reference (11x)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Unqualified enum name shadowed by the Page.NavigationCacheMode instance property.
errors_encountered.fix: Qualify the enum with its namespace (or drop the line).

errors_encountered.error: CS0102 The type 'MainPage' already contains a definition for 'AdvancedCaptureContext' (18x, all same error across retries)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent editing slip: the AdvancedCaptureContext helper class ended up defined twice inside MainPage.xaml.cs.
errors_encountered.fix: Removed the duplicate definition; final file has one at line 66.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated build failures on CS1061 Suspending/Resuming.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No skill guidance that WinUI 3 Application drops the Suspending/Resuming events; agent kept the UWP hookup.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A build-error entry + lifecycle-section note in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md and an inventory pattern that injects an inline TODO on the Suspending/Resuming subscription lines.
A build-error entry documenting the qualify-the-enum fix (the line ships in the standard UWP page template).

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: One-off copy/paste duplication by the agent.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: N/A — editing slip, not a migration-pattern gap.
